description: Returns an order's signed compliance receipt: an ES256 JWS with its decoded claims and a PDF link, covering records delivered, suppression removals, subscriber classes, TPS screening, Article 14 status, the licence and the file hash. Use it to prove to the user, a colleague or another agent that a list is licensed and screened; anyone can verify it with POST /v1/compliance/receipts/verify. Free; it needs orders:read. Lawful basis is UK GDPR Article 6(1)(f) legitimate interests; email audiences include corporate subscribers only by default (PECR), so sole traders and ordinary partnerships are left out unless the toggle is changed.
name: get_compliance_receipt

Licence.description: Licence terms as data, on every quote, order, records page and receipt. Records stay usable, pushable and re-downloadable free until reuse_until.

permitted_channels.description: email, telephone and post on standard terms.

reuse_until.description: Order date plus 12 months; null for outright.

terms_url.description: Where that version of the Data Licence and Sharing Agreement is published.

terms_version.description: The version of the Data Licence and Sharing Agreement the licence is under, such as 1.0.

type.description: multi_use_12m (12 month multi-use, every plan) or outright (1.8 credits a record, proposed).

ReceiptClaims.description: The decoded payload of a compliance receipt.

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the delivered file, lower case hex.

dataset_version.description: The immutable weekly build a count is bound to, such as 2026-W39. The last 52 stay queryable.

order_id.description: Format: an order id: ord_ followed by a 26 character ULID in upper case Crockford base32, such as ord_01JB4N9S3W2X6Y7Z8A1B2C3D4E.

receipt_id.description: Format: a compliance receipt id: rcpt_ followed by a 26 character ULID in upper case Crockford base32, such as rcpt_01JB4NA2Q5W8ZAK8Q2V7XN3M9R.

test.description: The receipt of a test mode order (a test key, or a demo organisation): its records are invented and it grants no licence. Absent on a live order's receipt.

verified_within_days.description: Share of delivered emails verified within 30, 60 and 90 days.

outputSchema.description: A signed compliance receipt for an order, verifiable by anyone with POST /v1/compliance/receipts/verify.

id.description: Format: a compliance receipt id: rcpt_ followed by a 26 character ULID in upper case Crockford base32, such as rcpt_01JB4NA2Q5W8ZAK8Q2V7XN3M9R.

jws.description: The receipt as a compact JWS signed with ES256.

kid.description: The signing key id in jwks_url.

order_id.description: Format: an order id: ord_ followed by a 26 character ULID in upper case Crockford base32, such as ord_01JB4N9S3W2X6Y7Z8A1B2C3D4E.

title: Get a compliance receipt
